system.description:
You transmute your vitae into a weakening poison that can be smeared on a blade, brought to the surface of your skin, spat at a foe, or slipped to an unwary victim to drink.

Each Blood Trait spent becomes poison; when the tainted vitae touches or is ingested by a victim she automatically loses one Physical Trait. You may deliver it with an unarmed strike (a Physical Challenge, causing the lost Trait on top of the blow), by coating a weapon of dagger-size or larger, by a kiss, or by spitting at anyone within ten feet (a Physical Challenge, declared beforehand). Any single attack carries only one Blood Trait and so drains only one Physical Trait, though a weapon can be pre-coated with several Traits for successive strikes. Altering your blood costs no action. Mortals reduced to zero Physical Traits this way fall deathly ill by the next night and do not heal normally; otherwise lost Physical Traits return next session.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
